tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (CX) Developer | Java, Spring & API Integration Expert
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering enterprise e-commerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot and REST/OCC APIs, with proven experience designing PIM-ERP-MDM integrations, data pipelines and API migrations. Skilled in CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, and production support. Strong techno-functional consultant: requirements analysis, user stories, stakeholder management and AI-assisted development. Holds SAP Commerce Cloud certification and valid German work permit.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

keywords_missing: SAP CX specific modules beyond Commerce

cover_en.subject: Application: [Post] We're Hiring | SAP IS-Utilities, SAP CX & FSM Professionals
cover_en.hook: I am excited to contribute to Brontobyte’s SAP IS-Utilities and CX initiatives. With over five years of hands-on experience delivering SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I have deep expertise in Java, Spring and API-driven integrations that align with your platform needs.

bullets.label: **Integration Expertise**
bullets.text: Designed and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines and resolved ERP/MDM integration bottlenecks, ensuring seamless product data flow across global channels.

bullets.label: **API Development**
bullets.text: Built and exposed OCC REST web services and headless APIs, enabling robust storefront and third-party integrations for high-traffic e-commerce environments.

bullets.label: **Techno-Functional Consulting**
bullets.text: Collaborated with business stakeholders to analyse requirements, author user stories and functional specs, translating them into scalable SAP Commerce solutions.

bullets.label: **Agile Delivery & CI/CD**
bullets.text: Led CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) using Docker and Kubernetes, supporting agile sprints and production stability.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, Germany, I hold a valid German residence and work permit, am serving notice until 15 December 2026 and can start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can add value to your team.

tailoring.why_company: Brontobyte’s commitment to advancing SAP IS-Utilities and Customer Experience solutions resonates with my passion for delivering high-impact, integration-focused e-commerce platforms. Your innovative approach to combining utilities management with SAP CX creates unique challenges where my proven SAP Commerce Cloud expertise, API integration experience, and techno-functional consulting skills can drive measurable value and support your growth trajectory.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to join Brontobyte to apply my SAP Commerce Cloud and integration expertise to your cutting-edge SAP IS-Utilities and CX projects, delivering robust, scalable solutions.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m eager to bring my Java, Spring and integration experience to Brontobyte’s SAP IS-Utilities and CX team. Open to discuss further!
tailoring.email_subject: Application – SAP IS-Utilities, SAP CX & FSM Professional Position
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the SAP IS-Utilities, SAP CX & FSM role. With over five years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am confident I can contribute to your team’s success.

Kind regards,
